question: The possible value of x satisfying ((143 div 13 times x-3 times 3))/((6²-7 times 5+x²))=1 is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Following the BODMAS rule to solve the equation

⇒ __143 ÷ 13__ × x - __3 × 3__ = 6² - __7 × 5__ + x²

⇒ 11 × x - 9 = 36 - 35 + x²

⇒ 11x - 9 = 1 + x²
